tool: built-in image_gen for terrain; SVG for fixed coastline and UI
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / cartographic terrain texture.
Generate a high resolution 2:1 rectangular realistic terrain TEXTURE PLATE for the fictional Ether world map. This is an INTERMEDIATE TERRAIN LAYER, not the final UI image: our renderer will cut the continents with the exact existing vector coastlines and replace all ocean areas afterward.

CRITICAL TECHNICAL REQUIREMENT: paint natural LAND TERRAIN across the ENTIRE rectangular canvas, edge to edge. NO OCEAN PIXELS ANYWHERE. Do not leave black, blue, transparent or blank background around continents. The land texture must continue through and well beyond every coastline in reference image 1. This intentional overscan prevents ocean gaps inside the final exact coastline masks. Use normal lowland/vegetation/stone fill outside the five intended continental zones, and small realistic inland lakes only where sensible. The final composition will reveal ONLY terrain inside the original exact land polygons. Therefore do not paint shore outlines, beaches, coastal water, ocean shelves or white border lines. No actual global coastline in this texture plate.

REFERENCE 1 is the 2:1 world map and locates the FIVE terrain regions; it is NOT a style reference. Ignore all numbers, grid lines, crosshairs and trade routes. Copy its relative regional positions and extents, but all regions must be surrounded by additional LAND-texture overscan rather than water.
REFERENCE 2 is the selected IGNIS terrain and UI visual style. Match its realistically textured soil, forest landcover, believable erosion and legible three-dimensional ridge relief, natural muted palette, pale snowy ridges and dark vegetation. Do not flatten mountain relief into contour diagrams. No miniature trees, city models, houses, giant world tree, icons, lettering, contour lines, painted outlines, parchment, cute JRPG art or ornamental fantasy motifs. No UI/text/bars; these are added deterministically later.

REGION PLACEMENT in normalized full-frame coordinates:
1. IGNIS TAIGA x=36.924%..63.076%, y=6.944%..31.944%. Broad northern continent, not a small island. Its within-region terrain must resemble reference 2: north transverse snowy rugged mountain belt, west stepped stone plateaus, central boreal forest basin and small lake chain, lower east broken mountains, gentler southern plains. IMPORTANT: this entire selected-reference terrain pattern is scaled into this rectangle; do NOT make the whole output a zoom of Ignis. Preserve the broad biome relationships of the accepted continent.
2. ARVENA x=7.041%..34.626%, y=21.111%..51.111%. Broad west continental terrain: temperate forested uplands toward northern interior, rich river lowlands and wooded coasts, variable muted green and brown agricultural/plain textures, modest mountain ranges. Not one giant desert, not an all-port illustration.
3. ORDAS x=18.211%..45.678%, y=53.194%..85.694%. Southwest continent: broad rocky inland highlands and eroded plateaus, fertile lower plains, south cooler foothills, mixed stone browns and natural green. Its northeast inner sea and narrow passage are part of the vector mask, so KEEP DRAWING LAND THERE in this texture; do not paint blue sea or canals in the plate.
4. SERADION x=68.142%..95.747%, y=20.278%..85.278%. Huge eastern continent, much taller than western ones: diverse terrain across equator with lush central humid landcover, branching rivers, broken mountain chains, some drier basins and savanna toward subtropical zones, cooler rugged southern highland. Do not cover it all in jungle, ruins or sand. No newly depicted cities/civilization. At world scale these are broad coherent terrain masses, detailed but not dense repeated miniature mountains.
5. NIVER spans full width x=0..100%, y=89%..100%, a continuous southern polar land strip all the way to the bottom edge. Snow and grounded glacial ice, subtle wind-sculpted surface and a few dark exposed rocky ridges. It joins left and right edges at the same visual character. Keep this entire bottom region covered by ice/land, NO WATER, no isolated central Antarctica island.

Art direction: premium grounded realistic RPG satellite-relief terrain like reference 2, slightly elevated-looking mountain shading is intentionally accepted. Detailed coherent large-scale geology, erosion and branching valleys. Fine forest cover as natural textured masses, no visible individual trees at world scale. Moderate relief contrast, diffuse daylight, sharp uniform detail, restrained organic colors. No dramatic atmospheric lighting, no clouds, no globe curvature, no celestial background, no depth of field, no oblique horizon or 3D spherical world. TWO-TO-ONE complete texture sheet. NO text, NO symbols, NO ocean, NO shorelines.
scope: Whole-world visual mockup; original 5 land polygons preserved verbatim; generated inland terrain is illustrative.
